elements.fix: Rebuild the chain as a flat U-shaped collar: 2 thin gold boxes (0.08 m) running from each shoulder down to the sternum, plus 1 round brass medallion (0.22 m disc, #f2cf83 with a #b8914e rim) at chest centre. Remove the other gold lumps. Hold the cream charter scroll slightly forward at chest height in the right hand. / Rebuild the chain as a flat collar: 8–10 gold boxes (#b8914e, 0.12×0.06×0.1) running over both shoulders and meeting at the sternum in a shallow V at y 1.30–1.40, lying on the coat surface (z ≈ 0.15–0.17). Hang the medallion as a cylinder rotated x=π/2 (disc facing +z), 0.28 m across, at y 1.18, z 0.18, with a #f2cf83 inner disc. Make the frock coat dark green-black #263f40 with visible tails behind (box below the hips), keep the trousers #30383b, and add a cream shirt front so the chain has contrast.

problems: It is a generic modern beagle with no visible period cue
The brass collar (0.23×0.08×0.2, #c89c42) is buried under the head and cannot be seen
elements.fix: Make the collar a visible 0.1 m-tall brass band, slightly wider than the neck, with a round brass tag hanging at the front. Optionally add a short leather lead stub. Mute the coat toward a rough working terrier or hound in brown/grey rather than a bright cartoon beagle.

problems: The mechanic reads well (flat cap, waistcoat, tool case).
The clerk's dark green jacket and her dark green ledger merge, and the ledger is invisible. Her arm is bent across her body in a way that looks broken at this scale.
The skirt is a single block flush with the jacket, so the figure reads as a green barrel.
elements.fix: Give the clerk a lighter ledger (#8b6245 cover, cream page edge) held at her side and clearly offset from the jacket. Straighten the arm into the base-figure pose with the hand on the ledger. Make the skirt flare slightly (0.55 m wide at the hem) and a contrasting colour (#42494c) against a #596f52 jacket, so jacket and skirt read separately. Make the pinned hair a visible bun box at the back.

problems: The footprint is 5.4×5.4 m on a 14 m lot and the top is about 14 m, so it reads as a lighthouse/pagoda and is barely taller than the home in the vignette scale.
The stepped tiers shrink to a 3 m top that looks like a chimney cap. The gold dome and flag are tiny.
The large paved forecourt and two hedges make the lot look empty.

World rule: designDirection (skyscraper): give a scale floor: the commercial building fills at least 10×10 m of the 14 m lot and reaches 15–17 m, the tallest thing in town, so it does not read as a narrow tower.
elements.fix: Widen the base to 10×10 m (stone ground floor 3 m) and go up to ~17 m in three set-backs (10, 8, 6 m wide). Add a heavy cornice (0.4 m pale stone band, 0.3 m overhang) at each set-back and tall arched windows in a regular grid. Crown it with a 2 m copper-green (#5f8f7f) mansard or dome plus a flagpole. Cut the forecourt to a 2 m entrance apron with steps.

problems: The brougham cab reads, but the horse is undersized and squat (back at roughly 1.1 m) with short stubby legs, so it looks like a pony or dog pulling a carriage taller than it.
The shafts pass through the horse's body instead of running along its flanks.
The black roof slab dominates the top view.
elements.fix: Scale the horse up: back height 1.6 m, legs 0.9 m long and 0.14 m thick, neck angled up 0.6 rad, head box 0.55 m long. Run the two shafts outside the horse's flanks at belly height, ending at a collar box. Lighten the cab roof to #30383b with a brass rail around the edge, and keep the red body and yellow-spoked wheels.
